plan: OpenVibe Updated Plan Based On Codebase (T0–T19) — the forum moved back to OpenVibe.Community (owner decision, 2026-10-08); Space becomes code hosting and spaces
deployment: Not deployed: Space publishes nothing yet. Unit deploy/systemd/openvibe-space.service on 127.0.0.1:4940, vhost deploy/nginx/openvibe.space.conf, database ov_space via OpenVibe.Host roles/data add-service.sh space. Every forum URL (/s and /s/*, /api/v1/spaces|posts|space-groups|relay) answers a permanent redirect to the same path and query on https://openvibe.community. The forum tables stay in ov_space; this release writes no drop migration.
features: the home page: what Space will host (code, dynamic pages, "spaces" apps) and where the forum went
permanent forum redirects: /s and /s/* (301 GET/HEAD, 308 otherwise) and the forum APIs (308) to openvibe.community
sign-in: the Network OAuth2 client `space` (login, callback, FedCM, logout, me, refresh)
discovery: robots.txt, llms.txt, llms-full.txt, sitemap.xml (the home page alone)
the process boots on a fresh database and stops cleanly (test/boot.test.js)
knownGaps: code hosting and dynamic pages are not built yet, and no "spaces" apps run here; the home page says so
openvibe-contracts still registers space.forum.read/manage, space.thread.read and space.post.write for Space; the Contracts update that retires or reassigns them is a separate change
the forum tables remain in ov_space (migrations 0001+ still create them) with their rows; no drop migration in this release
Space consumes no network events and has no account export/deletion: it holds no user content, and the forum's account data is Community's
